solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing; clues and answers read from cryptics.georgeho.org (ODbL)'s copy of the post, which drops the counts, so each count is read off the blogger's answer

clue.text: Armed force command could be the making of me! (9, three words)

blocks.note: surface reading: the order a gunman barks at a hold-up

blocks.clueFragment: could be the making of me!
blocks.note: setter's reading: in a down light, the two letters of 'em' read upwards spell me, so sticking that pronoun up makes me

explanation.surface: A robber with a gun boasts that one barked order could make his fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: STICK 'EM UP: take 'EM and stick it up (reverse it in a down entry) and you get ME, which is the 'making of me'.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the stock shouted order of an armed robber telling victims to raise their hands.

clue.text: Info right on Japanese Elder Statesmen

blocks.note: gen is slang for information
R is the abbreviation for right
O is a dictionary abbreviation for on

explanation.surface: Some briefing material has been passed on to senior Japanese politicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Info right on' looks like slang approval of good information, but each word is a separate piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The genro were the informal council of senior advisers who guided Japanese emperors in the Meiji and Taisho eras.

clue.text: Thin piece of iron used in fighting

indicators.note: something used in a thing is put inside it, so one piece sits within another

blocks.note: fighting is war
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A slim bit of iron being employed in battle, perhaps as a blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A wafer is any very thin slice or disc of material, from biscuit to silicon.

clue.text: Cook liked a lot of chana for dumplings

indicators.note: a lot of something is most but not all of it, so the word loses its tail
to cook is to work ingredients together, so the letters are mixed up

blocks.note: taken as written
chana, the Indian chickpea dish, without its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone who enjoyed lots of chickpea curry makes dumplings.
explanation.walkthrough: Chana is a South Asian chickpea dish; 'Cook' reads as the chef, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Kneidlach are matzo balls, the Jewish dumplings traditionally served in chicken soup.

clue.text: Time for my comment about large wine mixer

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the word runs the other way
one thing for another means swapped in to replace it

blocks.note: a comment is a remark
T is the abbreviation for time
M is a Chambers abbreviation for my, as in m'lud

explanation.surface: A host suggests it is time to remark on a big drinks blender.
explanation.walkthrough: REMARK reversed is KRAMER; then T replaces the M, which Chambers gives as short for my.
explanation.definitionFit: A krater was the large ancient Greek bowl in which wine was mixed with water before serving.

clue.text: Latest in online business boasts deeds held by third party

indicators.note: the latest in each word is the one at its very end

blocks.note: the final letter of online
the final letter of business
to crow is to boast

explanation.surface: A trendy internet firm brags about the newest tech it has.
explanation.definitionFit: An escrow is a deed or bond held by a neutral party until a condition is met; the plural fits deeds.

clue.text: Network with no end of reach in Dell estate

indicators.note: no end of a word means its final letter is taken away from the other piece
in places one piece within another

blocks.note: a dene is a small wooded valley, a dell
a mesh is a network
the last letter of reach, which is dropped

explanation.surface: A computer network installed throughout the grounds of a Dell company site, reaching nearly everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital on Dell suggests the computer firm, but it is a plain dell, a valley. The H that ends reach is removed from MESH.
explanation.definitionFit: A demesne is land an owner keeps for personal use, the estate attached to a manor.

clue.text: Wake up and it's sort of grey in Glasgow

indicators.note: in a down light, up means read from bottom to top

blocks.note: drail is a Chambers word for a trail, the track left behind, like a wake

explanation.surface: Waking in Glasgow and finding the sky a dreary grey.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter intended LIART (TRAIL reversed); LIARD, from DRAIL, is the grid's variant and Chambers lists both as Scots for grey.
explanation.definitionFit: Liard, like lyart, is a Scots word for grey or grizzled, hence 'in Glasgow'.

clue.text: Ask to be involved with aria showing lack of self-discipline

indicators.note: being involved means being tangled up together, so the letters are mixed

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A singer who demands to join in an aria shows little restraint.
explanation.definitionFit: Akrasia is the philosophers' term for weakness of will, acting against one's better judgement.

clue.text: Chatterer caught suggesting head should be sacked by Academy

indicators.note: sacking the head removes the leader, so the first letter goes

blocks.note: c is the cricket abbreviation for caught
noting is suggesting or remarking; its first letter is dropped
A is the abbreviation for Academy

explanation.surface: A gossip is caught hinting that the head teacher should be fired by the academy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chatterer' looks like the gossip of the story, but it is a bird; Chambers uses chatterer for the cotingas.
explanation.definitionFit: The cotingas are tropical American songbirds, also called chatterers for their calls.

clue.text: First from Europe came out after Tesla hybrid (7, two words)

indicators.note: first from a word means its opening letter is taken
after places the European pieces behind the car-unit piece, setting their order

blocks.note: T is the SI symbol for the tesla, the unit of magnetic flux density
the opening letter of Europe
arose means came out or emerged

explanation.surface: The first European model was launched after Tesla's hybrid car.
explanation.walkthrough: Tesla is the carmaker in the surface but the magnetic unit in the wordplay, and 'hybrid' is a plant, not a car.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea roses are hybrid garden roses bred from Chinese stock, scented like tea.

clue.text: Image that's backed before show once

indicators.note: backed means sent backwards, so the letters run in the opposite direction

blocks.note: ie, id est, means that is
kon is an obsolete form of con, which Chambers gives as to show or know

explanation.surface: A picture supported before being exhibited in the past.
explanation.definitionFit: Eikon is the Greek-derived spelling of icon, a likeness or image.

clue.text: Childhood home gets love from Will

blocks.note: in means at home
in Shakespeare fancy means love, as in 'Tell me where is fancy bred'

explanation.surface: A childhood home receives affection in someone's will.
explanation.walkthrough: Will is Shakespeare, not a legal document.
explanation.definitionFit: Infancy is the earliest stage of life, the period of babyhood and early childhood.

clue.text: Know-all heading off for movie

indicators.note: with its heading off, the word loses its first letter

blocks.note: a smarty is a know-all

explanation.surface: A know-it-all sets off to the cinema.
explanation.definitionFit: Marty is the 1955 Oscar-winning film about a lonely Bronx butcher.

clue.text: Island clubs connected to network

blocks.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in cards
a rete is an anatomical network of vessels or nerves

explanation.surface: An island's golf or social clubs are linked up to a network.
explanation.definitionFit: Crete is the largest Greek island, in the Mediterranean.

clue.text: A leader in angling is getting fish that are ferocious

indicators.note: the leader in a word is the letter at its front

blocks.note: per means a, as in ten pounds per head
the opening letter of angling
taken as written

explanation.surface: A top angler is landing fierce fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Perai is another name for the piranha, the notoriously savage South American fish.

clue.text: Fire room support after OK set mistreated

indicators.note: something mistreated is knocked about, so the letters are thrown out of order

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged
to hold is to support

explanation.surface: Backing for a fire room after an approved set was badly handled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts the support word at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A stokehold is the compartment of a steamship where the furnaces are fed.

clue.text: Recall touchy Republican agreed talks in Wellington

indicators.note: to recall is to call back, so the letters are read backwards

blocks.note: touchy means sore
R is short for Republican
OK means agreed

explanation.surface: A sensitive Republican remembers talks being agreed in the New Zealand capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand, flagging a Maori-derived NZ word.
explanation.definitionFit: Korero is New Zealand English, from Maori, for a talk or discussion.

clue.text: Following month in France, Elephant's Head for a glass

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: f is the abbreviation for following
avril is French for April
the opening letter of elephant

explanation.surface: Next month in France, an elephant's head will be made in glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Favrile is the iridescent art glass patented by Louis Comfort Tiffany.

clue.text: Large instrument picked up and it's accepted inside travelling box

indicators.note: in a down light, picked up means lifted so it reads bottom to top
inside places one piece within another

blocks.note: a harp is a large stringed instrument
it, with the 's read as is joining the next piece
A is the abbreviation for accepted

explanation.surface: A big instrument is lifted and accepted into its travel case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Large instrument' sounds like the box's contents, but it only supplies letters; A for accepted is a Chambers abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A pitarah is an Indian box or basket used to carry clothes on a journey.

clue.text: One wrestles with Chancellor taking risks regularly

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter is kept
one piece taking another holds it within

blocks.note: Rishi Sunak was Chancellor of the Exchequer when this was set
the second and fourth letters of risks

explanation.surface: Someone grapples with a Chancellor who keeps gambling.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chancellor of the Exchequer is the UK finance minister; IK goes in between RI and SHI, the order taken from the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: Rikishi is the Japanese term for a professional sumo wrestler.

clue.text: Monster with deep blue colour

blocks.note: w is short for with
indigo is a deep blue

explanation.surface: A dark blue beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The windigo is a cannibal spirit or monster in Algonquian folklore.

clue.text: Confined without acting, intention is to get cast

indicators.note: without means lacking, so a piece is taken away

blocks.note: an aim is an intention
A is a Chambers abbreviation for acting; it comes out of the intention word
to mew is to moult or cast feathers, as a hawk does

explanation.surface: An out-of-work actor hopes to land a part in a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'acting' and 'cast' paint a theatre scene; cast here is shed feathers, the sense of the hawk's mew.
explanation.definitionFit: To mew is to shut up or confine, like a hawk in its mews; immewed is the intensified form.

clue.text: Auxiliary is sharing two minutes for dietary disease

indicators.note: two things sharing a piece hold it between them, one either side

blocks.note: two Ms, M being short for minute
an aid is an auxiliary
taken as written

explanation.surface: A helper spends two minutes on a nutrition-related illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Maidism is pellagra caused by a diet relying on maize.

clue.text: Message received after day in W Indian boat

blocks.note: d is the abbreviation for day
roger is radio talk for message received

explanation.surface: A radio confirmation comes in a day after being sent from a Caribbean boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after day' puts the day letter in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A droger is a slow West Indian coasting vessel.

clue.text: Side of crag is for parking during breaks

indicators.note: one thing for another means it takes the other's place

blocks.note: stops are breaks
the contracted 's of it's
P is the road-sign letter for parking

explanation.surface: A climber's crag side is reserved for parking during rest stops.
explanation.definitionFit: Stoss is the geologists' term for the side of a crag facing the oncoming glacier.

clue.text: A maiden by Bishop lifted the West Indian paceman

blocks.note: taken as written
M is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for a maiden over
B is the chess notation for bishop
rose means lifted or went up

explanation.surface: Cricket report: a maiden over from Bishop raised the West Indian fast bowler's spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: Ian Bishop was also a West Indies fast bowler, so the surface stays on the cricket field. A paceman is a fast bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: Curtly Ambrose was the towering Antiguan fast bowler who spearheaded the West Indies attack in the 1990s.

clue.text: Indian staff ring up about little money

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece wraps another
in a down light, up means read from bottom to top

blocks.note: a halo is a ring of light
m, a short form of money

explanation.surface: Staff in India telephone about a small sum of cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring up' looks like a phone call; ring is the halo and up the reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: Omlah is an Anglo-Indian term for the native staff of officials in a court or office.

clue.text: Cutlery left almost entirely in Slovakia

indicators.note: almost entirely means nearly the whole, so the last letter is missing
in puts one piece inside another

blocks.note: SK is the international code for Slovakia
port is the left side of a ship; its last letter goes

explanation.surface: Some knives and forks were left behind, nearly all of them, in Slovakia.
explanation.definitionFit: A spork is a hybrid spoon and fork, a piece of cutlery.

clue.text: Potato dish needing injection of salt from the east

indicators.note: in an across light, coming from the east means read right to left
an injection puts something inside, so one piece goes into the other

blocks.note: a pie is a dish
a tar or salt is a sailor

explanation.surface: A potato dish that needs seasoning with some eastern salt.
explanation.walkthrough: Salt looks like seasoning, but an old salt and a tar are both sailors.
explanation.definitionFit: Pratie is an Irish dialect word for a potato.

clue.text: Ginger loves the going rate

blocks.note: love is zero in tennis, O, so two loves are OO
miles per hour is the rate at which a vehicle is going

explanation.surface: A redhead is fond of the market price.
explanation.walkthrough: Ginger here is the verb-turned-noun for liveliness, not hair or spice.
explanation.definitionFit: Ginger means vigour or spirit, as in ginger up; oomph is the same energy.

clue.text: Joe's recipe needing large Greek dish

blocks.note: GI Joe is a US soldier, so Joe gives GI; the 's links to the next word
R, from Latin recipe meaning take, heads prescriptions
OS is short for outsize, large

explanation.surface: Joe's cooking instructions call for a big Greek meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Giros is a variant spelling of gyros, Greek meat roasted on a vertical spit.

clue.text: Can finally get makeshift shelter

blocks.note: to twig is to get, understand
can is slang for a toilet, a loo

explanation.surface: A tin can at last becomes a temporary shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' sends the toilet word to the end. A twigloo is a shelter of branches built by road protesters.
explanation.definitionFit: A twigloo is a makeshift hut of branches, as built by environmental protesters camping in trees.

clue.text: Prince runs from sensational story leak

indicators.note: something that runs from a place leaves it, so a letter departs

blocks.note: a splash is a sensational front-page story
P is short for prince; it is removed

explanation.surface: A prince flees a scandalous tabloid story about a leak.
explanation.walkthrough: Leak looks like a press leak, but it is slang for urinating, as is slash.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang, to take a leak and to have a slash both mean to urinate.

clue.text: Cover with stones surprisingly repairable, publicity put out

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters end up in an unexpected order
put out means removed, so those letters are taken away

blocks.note: taken as written
to give something air is to publicise it; these letters are removed

explanation.surface: Gems cover something fixable, though the press release was withdrawn.
explanation.walkthrough: Stones here are gems, and the pearls are the stones.
explanation.definitionFit: To bepearl is to stud or cover with pearls, which are precious stones in a broad sense.

clue.text: Set on protecting shield designed for Indian officer

indicators.note: something designed is newly arranged, so the letters are reworked
a protector surrounds what it guards, holding it inside

blocks.note: to tar on is to incite or set on, as a dog
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A shield made for an Indian official is set to guard him.
explanation.definitionFit: A tehsildar is the revenue officer in charge of a tehsil, a district subdivision in India.
